title: Conformational Positioning of the LXCXE Motif of LTSV40 within an Ordered-Disordered Transition Drives pRb Binding Cleft Recognition.
authors: Padilla Franzotti, Carla Luciana; Pierdominici-Sottile, Gustavo; Palopoli, Nicolas; Palma, Juliana
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟研究LTSV40的LXCXE基序与pRb蛋白的结合机制，属于蛋白质-蛋白质互作而非TF-DNA体系，但MD方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作建模，故给予中档评分。
abstract: The retinoblastoma protein (pRb) is a central negative regulator of the eukaryotic cell cycle. Oncoproteins bearing the LXCXE motif can inactivate pRb, thereby promoting cell-cycle progression. One such protein is the Large T antigen of the Simian Virus 40 (LTSV40), which contains extensive intrinsically disordered regions. Taking advantage of available structural information for the LTSV40-pRb complex, we generated computational models of pRb bound to different LTSV40 constructs and investigated their energetic and dynamical features using molecular dynamics simulations. Our results show that the isolated LXCXE motif has low affinity for pRb, that flanking residues enhance binding asymmetrically, and that the full-length protein binds more strongly than peptide fragments. Mechanistically, residues N-terminal to the LXCXE motif drive initial recognition by adopting an alpha-helical conformation, while C-terminal residues engage at later stages. Further analysis reveals that this behavior arises from an ordered-motif-disordered architecture within the LTSV40 region responsible for pRb interaction. Bioinformatic analysis shows that this feature is conserved across polyomavirus Large T antigens, suggesting a general strategy for efficient pRb targeting. Overall, this work provides a molecular and energetic framework for LXCXE-mediated recognition, highlighting the interplay between local structure, intrinsic disorder, and sequence context in protein-protein interactions.
abstract_zh: 视网膜母细胞瘤蛋白（pRb）是 eukaryotic 细胞周期的核心负调控因子。携带 LXCXE 基序的癌蛋白可使 pRb 失活，从而促进细胞周期进程。其中一种蛋白是猿猴病毒 40 的大 T 抗原（LTSV40），其包含广泛的内在无序区域。利用 LTSV40-pRb 复合物现有的结构信息，我们生成了 pRb 与不同 LTSV40 构建体结合的计算模型，并通过分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟研究了其能量和动力学特征。结果表明，孤立的 LXCXE 基序对 pRb 的亲和力较低，侧翼残基不对称地增强结合，且全长蛋白比肽段片段结合更强。机制上，LXCXE 基序 N 端的残基通过采用 α-螺旋构象驱动初始识别，而 C 端残基在后期阶段参与结合。进一步分析揭示，这种行为源于 LTSV40 中负责 pRb 相互作用区域内的有序-基序-无序架构。生物信息学分析显示，这一特征在多瘤病毒大 T 抗原中保守，提示了一种高效的 pRb 靶向通用策略。总体而言，本研究为 LXCXE 介导的识别提供了分子和能量框架，强调了局部结构、内在无序性和序列背景在蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用中的相互作用。
